summary.intent: Fix all outstanding confirmed review findings in the Callisto release tool, each on its own branch/PR linked to Entire trails, so the trail branches can be merged. This segment began with the tag push refspec fix.
summary.outcome: Created branch fix/tag-push-explicit-refspec, changed the release tag push to use the full refs/tags/X:refs/tags/X refspec in provider/tag.rs, added a changeset, and ran tests, clippy, and fmt. The commit and push were retried after a session-trailer rejection and a signing failure, and their final success is not confirmed in the transcript.

repo: Each fix goes on its own branch from origin/main with a targeted test, a changeset when user-visible, and a link to trail #198, with PR text set via gh pr edit on the PR Entire opens.
Commits must not include a Claude-Session trailer, per the user's memory rule.
Commit signing (GPG) must run outside the sandbox.
Changesets live in .changeset/*.md, with front matter like `callisto-cli: patch`.
A branch named fix/tag-push-explicit-refspec already existed as an empty branch at origin/main, so it was switched to rather than recreated.

code.finding: The tag push used a bare `push <endpoint> <name>`. It is now an explicit `refs/tags/<name>:refs/tags/<name>` refspec, so a branch with the same name as the tag cannot make the push ambiguous.
The release harness contains push invocations that were checked for compatibility with the refspec change.

workflow: Use /usr/bin/git explicitly, and avoid heredocs and complex substitutions because the worktree guard refuses them.
Run cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings and cargo fmt --check before committing.
Commands that need signing or network access must be run unsandboxed after a sandbox-caused failure.

friction: The first commit attempt failed because of the session trailer rule, and the retry failed because signing needs to run outside the sandbox.
The branch name already existed, so `git switch -c` failed and the branch had to be inspected and switched to.
The worktree guard and sandbox restrictions kept forcing commands to be rewritten.
open_items: Confirm that the tag-push commit and push succeeded, then open or link the PR and trail #198.
Fix the receipt that says `published` when the publish client reported already-published.
Fix the WorkspaceCargoResolver BOM/CRLF loss, the cargo registry `url` that is accepted but ignored, and yarn dropping `--registry`.
Fix the dispatched release skipping the verify gate, the attestation checks that need --source-ref/--signer-ref, and the late npm publishes that get almost no confirmation window.

Fix the pre-mode prerelease planning bug, the E320 `.all()` misalignment, the changelog indent match, the `overrides: "$name"` rewrite, the duplicate promoted-package changelog title, the interrupted-asset-upload E167, and the release-commit path check.
Handle slop trails #194-#199, the render_snapshot diagnostics, the soft-failure suspects, the bench fidelity fixes, and the verification pass for agent-reported findings.
User and Entire actions are still pending: approving gates, closing merged trails, resolving findings, cleaning up leftover worktrees, and the decisions on trail #179 and OIDC trusted publishing.
Tell the user once every finding is either fixed in a PR or listed as needing their decision.
